annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage BUSD programs as tiered participation opportunities involving entry payments, activation controls, stated returns, and payouts linked to bringing members into the system. It also asks viewers to share the presentation and displays partner, profit, and referral-link figures that illustrate the promoted recruitment model. Although a separate graphic challenges the scam characterization and the figures are not verified, that material does not remove the described promotional claims.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The described paid levels route member payments through X3 and X4, with payouts tied to bringing members, upline recipients, and recycled positions. The speaker encourages activation.
